Videos used as a fake webcam when testing pose tracking in headless Chrome.

| File | What it shows | In git? |
|---|---|---|
| `four-dancers.mp4` | Four people dancing in a line, full body, with some overlap. 720×1280 portrait, 24 s. Used for multi-body tracking (Phase 3). | No. It's a third-party clip and this repo is public, so it's listed in `.gitignore`. Keep a local copy. |
